# Workspace Instructions

- This workspace is a no-build static web dashboard: `index.html`, `prototype.css`, `prototype.js`, and `upgrade.js`. Preserve direct browser opening and GitHub Pages compatibility; `upgrade.js` augments the existing application rather than replacing its calculations.
- Keep the visual language geotechnical and engineering-focused: deep navy, restrained cyan, explicit units, readable charts/tables, and terrain/section diagrams.
- Keep the Factor of Safety equations and prototype risk score deterministic and disclose their assumptions/weights.
- Label the weighted heuristic as a prototype, not a trained AI/ML model. Never invent model predictions, metrics, datasets, accuracy, or validation outputs.
- Keep simulated monitoring clearly labeled and distinct from field sensor data. Do not imply the GIS demo is a surveyed location.
- Treat every result and threshold as academic screening, not engineering design advice. Retain the professional disclaimer.
- Validate all demo/what-if scenarios, threshold editing, sensitivity charts, report/history actions, GIS disclosure, and responsive layouts after changes. No Node.js toolchain is available.
